name: TC-BF-004 — 产运确认Brief通过 [P0]
description: 验证产运确认Brief后迭代进入IN_PRODUCTION，Brief版本状态变为已确认

steps.expression: (() => { const text = document.body.textContent; const briefContent = document.querySelector('[class*=brief], [class*=readonly]'); const confirmBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('确认 Brief') || b.textContent.includes('确认Brief')); const rejectBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('驳回')); return { briefVisible: !!briefContent || text.length > 100, confirmBtn: !!confirmBtn, rejectBtn: !!rejectBtn }; })()

(() => { const tabs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-tabs-tab')).map(t => t.textContent.trim()); const steps = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[class*=step-item], [class*=step]')).map(s => s.textContent.trim()); return { tabs, stepsPreview: steps.slice(0, 6) }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: 迭代状态为PENDING_BRIEF，当前用户是产运
_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 进入Brief tab
2. 验证Brief内容只读展示
3. 验证底部操作栏展示确认Brief和驳回Brief
4. 点击确认Brief
_testDesign.expectedResult:
1. Brief内容只读展示
2. 底部展示确认Brief和驳回Brief按钮
3. 确认后迭代进入IN_PRODUCTION
4. 时间线追加确认事件
_testDesign.groupPath: 风格店铺协作平台/Brief协作
